name: Topheth
line: Topheth was a place in the Valley of Ben-hinnom near Jerusalem where children were burned in the fire, and God warned it would become a burial ground.

moments.title: Topheth Made Unclean
moments.text: King Josiah made Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom unclean. He did this so that no one could sacrifice a son or daughter in the fire to Molech there.

moments.title: A Place of Child Sacrifice
moments.text: The LORD said the people of Judah built the high places of Topheth to burn their sons and daughters in the fire. He said He never commanded it, and it never even entered His mind.

moments.title: The Valley of Slaughter
moments.text: The LORD said Topheth would one day be called the Valley of Slaughter. The dead would be buried there until there was no more room.

moments.title: The Shattered Jar
moments.text: At Topheth, Jeremiah was to shatter a jar and say that God would shatter Jerusalem the same way. The LORD said He would make the city like Topheth.

moments.title: Jeremiah Returns to the Temple
moments.text: The LORD had sent Jeremiah to Topheth to deliver God's message. Then he went back to the courtyard of the LORD's house and told all the people that disaster was coming because they would not listen.
